paragraphs.text: Zero mana is a mana cost that can be paid without spending resources.

The action necessary for a player to pay such a cost (casting, activating, etc.) is the player's acknowledgment that they are paying it. Even though such a cost requires no resources, it's not automatically paid.

Zero mana was first used in Limited Edition Alpha on the Moxen as well as the Black Lotus . Zero mana appears predominantly on artifacts , which are due to the lack of a colored mana symbol: colorless . Kobolds and the Pact cycle are have a color indicator .
Keywords like affinity can reduce a cost to zero
